text: おまえも　あって　みると　いいぜ！

structure.jp: あって　みると　いいぜ！

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by と いい is a suggestion: 'it'd be good if you did'. あって みると いい = 'you should try meeting him'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て form means giving something a try. あって みる = 'try meeting him'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky boys' talk that pushes the statement at the listener. いいぜ = 'it'd be good, I tell you!'
